analysis.evidence: יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים says that two sons were born to Eber. The verse names them Peleg and Joktan.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וּ means “and.” The preposition לְ marks Eber, a personal name, as the father to whom the sons were born.
analysis.sense: Eber, the ancestor whose descendants are named here
